title: PIXL 8000 Black Cherry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Black Cherry PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod delivers a rich, authentic Cherry flavour with juicy, darker fruit tones for a super-satisfying fruit vape experience. If you love a classic Cherry flavour with a little more mystique, then look no further than PIXL’s Black Cherry. This prefilled pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a smooth and satisfying throat hit with fast-acting nicotine absorption. Designed exclusively for the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, each pod is paired with a 10ml refill reservoir that connects securely to the device, enabling the pod to automatically refill itself until the reservoir is empty — supporting up to 8000 puffs per kit. The 2ml pod uses mesh coil technology for consistent vapour and flavour from start to finish. It’s designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, producing smooth, satisfying draws with minimal maintenance. Simply insert the pod into your PIXL 8000 device, activate Boost Mode with a double-tap if preferred, and vape. Black Cherry is just one of over 25 distinctive flavours available in the PIXL 8000 range, each offering effortless vaping and vibrant character.
